template_preparation: Pre-render the model-native chat template with thinking disabled; supervise assistant response only, then pass through the empty template.
notes: Descriptive sanitized Gemma 4 settings, not a launch-ready training job. Add your own licensed models, labeled data and output directories; follow upstream installation requirements. The prior Gemma 3 context is descriptive and does not change the supplied Gemma 4 YAML.
scope: Four primary Gemma 4 E4B/12B JO/FT runs with training/data seed 42; the accompanying YAML is a primary-run Gemma 4 starting point.

prior_gemma3_context.implementation_comparison: The same seven projection types are selected automatically for Gemma 3 and explicitly for Gemma 4. Chat-template handling and training software differ; this is not an identical-implementation comparison.

second_seed_replicate.scope: Separate checkpoint-selection replication of the primary E4B JO run. Does not add primary quality/precision cells or serving measurements, and does not use an independent data split.
